title: The Balemba of the Zoutpansberg (Transvaal)
author: Henri A. Junod

translation.name: The Balemba of the Zoutpansberg (Transvaal) — Henri A. Junod

rights: Public domain (published 1908; author d. 1934). Scan and OCR: Internet Archive (IGNCA copy of Folk-Lore vol. XIX).
citation: Junod, Henri A. “The Balemba of the Zoutpansberg (Transvaal).” Folk-Lore 19, no. 3 (1908): 276–287.
editorialMarkers: A Swiss missionary-ethnographer’s field report on the Lemba (Balemba) among the Venda and Tsonga: their separateness, crafts, food and slaughter rules, circumcision, and the “Semitic” comparison he draws. A primary account of its time; its racial vocabulary and comparisons are the author’s.
method: Internet Archive OCR text between the article’s start and end markers; running heads and page numbers dropped; hyphenation joined; paragraphs broken by a page turn rejoined when the next block starts lowercase. OCR errors are not corrected.
